answer: Rule: the registry scores behavioral correlation. Every identity locks 30 units and publishes an action fingerprint each epoch; identities whose votes and trades match above 90 percent in the same epoch are merged into one cluster and every member's deposit is slashed. One fake risks 30 units, but ten lockstep fakes lose all 300 units at once, so copying behavior past the horizon of one identity collapses the whole nebula of clones into a single sonnet of evidence.
